newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Feb 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Feb 25.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on the front page of its business page on Tuesday:

WASHINGTON - Rupert Murdoch's News Corp said it would spend $1 billion for a 50 percent stake in Echostar Communications Corp in a merger that will likely shake up the fast-growing market for direct-broadcast satellite television.
WASHINGTON - Competition in the utility industry could trim the $40 million electricity bill of the Washington area's Metro transit system.

WASHINGTON - Securities and Exchange Commission Chairman Arthur Levitt, Jr. will propose Tuesday new rules intended to make it easier for investors to select from the thousands of available mutual funds.
WASHINGTON - AFC Enterprises, owner of Church's Chicken and Popeyes Chicken & Biscuit franchises, will buy Chesapeake Bagel Bakery for nearly $30 million.
